idea-plugin.name: TypeScript Test Data
idea-plugin.description:
TypeScript Test Data — valid fixtures for Vitest / Jest, offline

Generate an idiomatic TypeScript Vitest/Jest it.each table test whose rows are spec-valid values — and their invalid variants — straight from the Kassi engine. Unlike a hand-rolled faker, every "valid" row passes the real checksum (IBAN mod-97, card Luhn, national-ID schemes), and every "invalid" row is wrong on purpose. 100% offline and deterministic.

  • IBAN (ISO 13616 mod-97), card PAN (Luhn, test BINs) and national ID (NL/DE/AU/GB/CY) kinds — each a ready it.each table with valid + invalid rows.
  • Pick a kind, Generate, Copy into your .test.ts. Loads in WebStorm and every IntelliJ-based IDE.

Open it from View ▸ Tool Windows ▸ TS Test Data.
